summary: Boston Omaha Corp., as a seller along with other equityholders, signed a Securities Purchase Agreement to divest 100% of General Indemnity Group LLC (GIG) to CopperPoint Insurance Company for $84.3 million in cash. Approximately 93% of net proceeds go to Boston Omaha; GIG will also return 2.7M Sky Harbour shares and distribute $327k in cash pre-close. The agreement includes a two-year escrow, $5.25M indemnification cap, no financing contingency, and customary regulatory covenants. Watch for regulatory approvals and closing mechanics.
